title.zh-TW: 操作說明就在系統裡，不在另一份文件裡
title.en-US: Help is built into the system, not kept in a separate document

description.zh-TW: 這套系統的操作導覽和畫面綁在一起維護：畫面改了，導覽會跟著改，改壞了測試會擋下來。所以不會發生手冊上寫的按鈕在系統裡找不到、或是文件停留在半年前版本的情況。接下來兩步說明你之後要怎麼找到它們。
description.en-US: This system's guided tours are maintained together with its screens: when a screen changes, its tour changes with it, and if a change breaks a tour, tests catch it. So you'll never find a manual describing a button that doesn't exist in the system, or documentation stuck on a version from six months ago. The next two steps show you how to find the tours later.

title.zh-TW: 需要操作說明時回到這裡
title.en-US: Come back here whenever you need help

description.zh-TW: 每個功能都有自己的導覽，全部列在這個選單裡，需要時自己點開，不會主動跳出來打斷你。交接業務、代理他人職務，或隔很久沒碰某個功能時特別用得上；選單也會標示哪些你還沒看過。清單只列出你這個角色有權限的功能，看不到的代表你現在沒有那個權限，不是導覽漏寫。
description.en-US: Every feature has its own tour, and they're all listed in this menu. Open one yourself whenever you need it; tours never pop up on their own to interrupt you. They're especially handy when you take over someone's work, cover for a colleague, or return to a feature you haven't used in a long time. The menu also shows which ones you haven't viewed yet. The list only includes features your role has permission to use. If you can't see one, it means you don't currently have that permission, not that its tour is missing.

title.zh-TW: 你目前的生效角色決定看得到哪些功能
title.en-US: Your active role determines which features you can see

description.zh-TW: 系統依「生效角色」決定選單與操作權限。同一個帳號可能被指派多個角色，這裡可以切換：聯集模式下能同時生效多個角色，取消勾選就是暫時降權；稽核模式下一次只有一個角色生效。如果找不到預期中的功能，先確認這裡有沒有切錯，再回報權限問題——多數「功能不見了」其實是角色沒切。
description.en-US: The system uses your "Active Role" to decide which menus and actions are available to you. One account may be assigned several roles, and you can switch them here: in union mode, several roles can be active at once, and unchecking one temporarily lowers your permissions; in audit mode, only one role is active at a time. If you can't find a feature you expected, first check here that you haven't switched to the wrong role before reporting a permission problem. Most cases of "the feature is gone" turn out to be a role that wasn't switched.
